concepts.title: 01 / Y DE CREMA
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE exceptionally polished original graphic design brand exploration board, landscape 3:2, for the existing custom birthday cake business "Cakes by Yas" near Houston, Texas, with English and Spanish customers. This is a complete new brand direction proposed by a professional identity studio, not a recolor of the old script cake logo. Brand: personal custom birthday cakes, celebration, joy, handcrafted care, confident approachable premium. Website context: huge warm heavy grotesk headings, ivory backgrounds, coral and pale pink color blocks, arches, editorial large cake photography, flowing energetic shapes. Keep relevance to that website. Brand name MUST be exactly "Cakes by Yas", with spaces, easy to read. Do not rename to Yas alone. Show a professionally drawn unique standalone isotipo symbol prominently and consistently, independent from the wordmark. It must be legible as a flat one-color silhouette without gradients, fine details or effects. All logos flat vector-like, no stock logo clipart, no four-point stars, no chef hats, no wheat, no crowns, no utensils, no fake founding date, no established date, no fake certifications or claims. Strong optical design, custom kerning and restrained well-made original graphic forms.
Board composition: sophisticated clean art-directed grid on warm ivory, generous margins. Small top-left route number and Spanish concept title as supplied. Upper 60 percent: giant main logo lockup in open space, dominant enough to judge; include a large standalone symbol near it. Lower 40 percent: three deliberate sections, left shows identical mark as black-on-ivory and ivory-on-color plus a small round social avatar, middle has 4 large color swatches with their hex labels, right has a realistic minimal closed cake box mockup with the exact SAME identity printed, fully visible, warm studio lighting. Only the box mockup is photographic; rest perfectly flat graphics. Repeat logo geometry exactly throughout. No fake cakes presented as business products, no photos of cakes, no webpage screenshot. Typography and graphic execution must express the particular route below rather than repeat a template style. Print only requested title, brand name, palette codes, and optional phrase specified; no explanation paragraphs or gibberish.
Text title (verbatim): 01 / Y DE CREMA
Palette (exact proposed swatch hex codes): #EA677D, #F8A8B1, #FAF5EE, #352127
Direction: Concept: the most ownable, confident signature for Yas. Invent a compact bold monogram Y made from a single piped buttercream ribbon, two soft round forks joining a gently curved lower stroke with a tapered piping finish, subtle asymmetry and sculptural negative spaces. It reads clearly as the letter Y FIRST and edible piped frosting SECOND, NOT a generic cupcake, not flames, not horns or a plant. Coral Y symbol, extremely simplified and with clear continuous silhouette. Beside it, original heavy rounded-but-not-bubbly grotesk wordmark "Cakes by Yas", two lines if needed, cocoa ink, with playful unusual terminals and excellent kerning. This is a modern editorial cake studio, joyful and adult, not bridal script. Optional small phrase "Made for your day." Logo should have impact at avatar size. Box ivory with large coral Y and cocoa wordmark; pale pink side panel.
concepts.finalRefinementPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit this Cakes by Yas brand direction board. Preserve the exact board layout, background, title "01 / Y DE CREMA", wordmark "Cakes by Yas", color swatches and hex labels, tagline, packaging, font style and proportions. Change ONLY the pink standalone monogram and its repeated versions on the lower panels, circular avatar and box. Replace the current long two-droplet-and-swirl silhouette with a clearly readable CAPITAL LETTER Y made from piped buttercream: ONE connected bold solid geometric letter, short wide arms branching at 45 degrees, arms spread generously and a long strong nearly vertical lower stem. Broad constant-weight strokes, gently softened outer corners, a very slight piping wave at the two upper cut ends, a subtle angled taper at the bottom of the stem. The Y must be instantly recognizable as a capital Y in one second at 24 pixels. The symbol is compact 1:1, modern confident distinctive typography rather than an illustration. Remove all long oval droplet lobes, remove lower spiral, remove all internal tiny curlicues. NOT a rabbit or animal, NOT a tulip, NOT a flame. Solid flat coral #EA677D with no gradient or shading. Use EXACTLY the same new Y geometry in all repeated applications. Preserve everything else. Keep generous space between the Y and wordmark, no collision.

Design a thick geometric rounded triangular cake wedge as seen from the side, with one generous curved negative-space filling layer that also reads as a subtle smile, soft upper edge with only two sculptural frosting lobes. Direction: Concept: own the instant before blowing out a birthday candle. Invent a two-part very compact pictorial logo: a broad upside-down U arch as the candle/cake body and one joyful tilted teardrop flame floating above. The arch has a cleverly cut central negative space so together it suggests a tiny birthday cake with ONE candle, like a memorable ceremonial doorway. Do NOT use letter Y or frosting swoosh; NO crowns, NO stars, NO generic thin-line candle, no radiating rays. Wide confident flat silhouette with a slightly offset flame, maximum 3 geometric shapes, subtle hand-drawn warmth. Main symbol rich raspberry. Pair with tall elegant yet weighty custom condensed grotesk wordmark "Cakes by Yas" in 2 lines, deliberately sophisticated and energetic, not wedding script. Echo arches and a single flame in secondary graphics, pale blush blocks on warm cream. Box raspberry with cream logo and single pale pink arched wrap. Optional phrase "Make it a Yas day." Warm intimate birthday ritual, polished modernity.

Direction: Concept: modern confectionery atelier, expressive feminine sophistication, hand piping as a personal signature without restricting brand to weddings. More like a sculpted cake icing rosette than a botanical flower, no leaves, no stems, no thin details, compact scalloped silhouette. One subtly elongated lower lobe makes it recognizably asymmetric. Direction: Concept: character-led celebration identity. Create a charismatic original little cake mascot: a low wide single-layer cake body with pillowy scalloped icing on top, one short bent candle with a small leaf-shaped flame, two tiny vertical cocoa eyes and a wide asymmetrical smile; short curved arms, small rounded feet, a joyful leaning stance as if inviting you to a birthday party. Restrict to 2 flat inks, dark cocoa and coral plus cream negative space, thick consistent expressive rounded strokes, a simple readable silhouette, NOT a cupcake, NOT a slice, no gloves, no chef hat, not childish nursery art. It should appeal to adults planning birthdays too. Main independent isotipo is this character, shown large and as a social avatar; ensure it retains cake shape. Pair with exuberant original chunky hand-lettered sans wordmark "Cakes by Yas" in 2 lines, tightly kerned with gentle bounce and one custom curving terminal, NOT thin cursive. Flat cheerful illustrator energy, sophisticated street-food brand craft. Broad wavy coral stripes secondary pattern. Cream cake box with small proud mascot and oversized cocoa wordmark, pink lid. Optional phrase "Good things start with cake."
